cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：心爱的
cards.example_en: She read her beloved diary again on the train home.
cards.example_zh: 她在回家的火车上又读了一遍心爱的日记。

cards.example_en: You can bend the wire into a hook for the picture.
cards.example_zh: 你可以把这根铁丝弯曲成挂钩，用来挂画。

cards.example_en: A deep blush spread across her face.
cards.example_zh: 她脸上泛起了一片深深的红晕。

cards.example_en: The basketball will bounce off the gym wall.
cards.example_zh: 篮球会从体育馆的墙上反弹回来。

cards.example_en: The bride smiled as she walked into the hall.
cards.example_zh: 新娘微笑着走进了大厅。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：加拿大的
cards.example_en: My Canadian uncle coaches ice hockey at a local rink.
cards.example_zh: 我的加拿大叔叔在当地溜冰场教冰球。

cards.example_en: The case of the missing keys worried everyone.
cards.example_zh: 钥匙不见了，这个情形让大家都担心。

cards.example_en: Each cell in the leaf needs sunlight to live.
cards.example_zh: 叶子里的每个细胞都需要阳光才能存活。

cards.example_en: The monitor will compile our scores into one chart.
cards.example_zh: 班长会把我们的分数汇总成一张表。

cards.example_en: I filed a complaint because the locker room had no hot water.
cards.example_zh: 更衣室没有热水，我为此提交了投诉。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：组成部分
cards.example_en: The missing component was a tiny screw from the robot's arm.
cards.example_zh: 缺少的那个组成部分是机器人手臂上的一颗小螺丝。

cards.example_en: The office made an extra copy of my form for the school file.
cards.example_zh: 办公室多做了一份我的表格副本，放进学校档案。

cards.example_en: The copyright page says we may not photocopy the whole chapter.
cards.example_zh: 版权页写明我们不可以复印整个章节。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：当前的
cards.example_en: The current timetable is pinned on the board by the office.
cards.example_zh: 当前的时刻表钉在办公室旁边的布告板上。

cards.example_en: Our debate on school uniforms ran longer than the lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 我们关于校服的辩论比午休时间还长。
